observed_bottleneck: Compressed-region frozen PES has the leading trusted-force discrepancy
evidence: At R=1.0 correlated frozen-PES slope misses trusted force by 0.0393 Ha/bohr while SWCT is within 0.00259 Ha/bohr of that slope; current SR objective averages energies only
proposed_mathematical_change: One preregistered energy-plus-derivative/Sobolev objective with frozen weights and independent geometry holdout
expected_scientific_benefit: Directly tests whether the shared state can represent correct energy and local slope without endless tuning
expected_speed_benefit: May reduce downstream force-estimator/sample work only indirectly
expected_memory_benefit: No material change beyond derivative target statistics
expected_state_evaluation_reduction: None during evaluation; training cost increases because derivative targets are evaluated
scientific_risk: HIGH: force labels or weights can overfit and smoothness can be physically wrong
smallest_falsifying_experiment: One closed baseline-vs-derivative-aware training run with compressed/intermediate holdout and unchanged PES/dissociation gates
rollback_criterion: Any holdout/PES regression seed fragility or post-hoc weight need

observed_bottleneck: Current numerical SWCT evaluates five states/local energies per configuration
evidence: 360000 evaluations for 72000 samples; mixed d/dR of electronic Laplacian absent; SWCT variance reduction is 572x-2623x
proposed_mathematical_change: Propagate one nuclear-directional mixed derivative/JVP through the Java graph following differential SWCT; avoid a full third-order tensor
expected_scientific_benefit: Removes finite-difference truncation and preserves the leading low-variance estimator if equivalence passes
expected_speed_benefit: Potentially substantial; compare 5N traversals with N more-expensive fused primal/directional traversals
expected_memory_benefit: Target O(D) directional payload per graph node rather than O(D^3) dense third derivatives
expected_state_evaluation_reduction: Best-case 5N independent state traversals to N fused traversals; wall-time factor must be measured
scientific_risk: HIGH: cusp stability Jacobian signs units and mixed derivatives
smallest_falsifying_experiment: Analytic-state oracle then per-sample H2 comparison across several symmetric FD steps before aggregate timing
rollback_criterion: Any unexplained term/tail/sign/unit discrepancy or dense third-order storage

observed_bottleneck: No estimator passes all trusted-force gates and force distributions are pathological
evidence: AC-ZVZB best diagnostic RMSE about 0.0217 but fails max error; SWCT low variance but does not repair frozen PES slope
proposed_mathematical_change: Preregister Linteau acceptance-ratio Pulay and compact HF estimators one intervention at a time
expected_scientific_benefit: May improve controlled bias/variance once PES-target error is separated
expected_speed_benefit: Potential orders-of-magnitude sample reduction; unknown before benchmark
expected_memory_benefit: O(1) worker moments plus bounded tail diagnostics
expected_state_evaluation_reduction: Fewer samples only if uncertainty and bias gates pass
scientific_risk: HIGH: regularization bias and altered estimator target
smallest_falsifying_experiment: Frozen-state R=1.0/1.4/3.0 A/B on identical configurations with full tail/bias/cost audit

observed_bottleneck: Dense covariance accumulation/solve cannot scale to large neural states
evidence: Current code materializes P-by-P matrices and dense elimination; present P=20 is not yet the measured bottleneck
proposed_mathematical_change: Stream v-><O~(O~T v)>+lambda v and solve by PCG
expected_scientific_benefit: Same SR direction within locked residual tolerance
expected_memory_benefit: O(P^2) toward O(P) when streamed; optional O(NP) cached observables
expected_state_evaluation_reduction: No QM state reduction necessarily; removes pairwise covariance work
scientific_risk: MEDIUM: stochastic conditioning and early solve error
smallest_falsifying_experiment: Dense equivalence at P=20 then known-spectrum replay at P=1k/10k
rollback_criterion: Direction/residual/energy prediction outside tolerance or worse intended-regime cost

observed_bottleneck: Matrix-free SR may require too many Krylov iterations
evidence: Wavefunction has natural parameter groups; FFX shows architectural value of separating physical preconditioner and iterative solver
proposed_mathematical_change: Compare diagonal then fixed Jastrow/orbital/geometry/layer blocks; Kronecker approximation only after simpler blocks
expected_scientific_benefit: No target change; better-conditioned faithful SR solve
expected_speed_benefit: Fewer PCG iterations and operator passes
expected_memory_benefit: Diagonal O(P); blocks O(sum block_size^2); Kronecker structure-specific
expected_state_evaluation_reduction: Reduces repeated covariance-operator passes, not state generation unless observables are replayed
scientific_risk: MEDIUM: biased/unstable updates if blocks are unjustified
smallest_falsifying_experiment: Known-spectrum and frozen H2 replay with locked solve residual and update equivalence
rollback_criterion: Predominantly bound/regularization controlled behavior or non-reproducible convergence

observed_bottleneck: Observable-specific paths can repeat valid intermediates
evidence: Current dependency graph supports reuse but numerical SWCT still has distinct displaced traversals; one configuration is the expensive unit
proposed_mathematical_change: One immutable observable request and graph plan producing Psi/logPsi derivatives Laplacian local energy forces and SR statistics
expected_scientific_benefit: Reduces opportunity for inconsistent duplicate scientific calculations
expected_speed_benefit: Avoid duplicate node traversal/allocation; magnitude profile-dependent
expected_memory_benefit: Liveness policy retains mandatory nodes and recomputes cheaper large nodes
expected_state_evaluation_reduction: Count unique graph nodes once per valid state; cannot merge scientifically distinct geometries
scientific_risk: MEDIUM: false sharing of non-identical states
smallest_falsifying_experiment: Node-count/checksum audit on a frozen sample set before/after fusion
rollback_criterion: Any scientific identity conflation or derivative mismatch

observed_bottleneck: Human decimal formatting caused archival replay stop
evidence: Historical %.16g values differ by one ULP at two geometries although physics is unchanged
proposed_mathematical_change: Persist IEEE-754 bits plus Double.toHexString plus human decimal in a typed checksummed envelope
expected_scientific_benefit: Exact restart/replay and unambiguous distinction between archival and physical mismatch
expected_speed_benefit: Avoids wasted reruns and false stops
expected_state_evaluation_reduction: Prevents recomputation caused solely by lossy serialization
scientific_risk: LOW if historical files remain immutable
smallest_falsifying_experiment: Round-trip edge-value corpus and frozen scalar copies across JSONL restart locale and duplicate resolution
rollback_criterion: Any finite bit change or identity dependence on presentation decimal

observed_bottleneck: Sequential mutable accumulators limit safe concurrency
evidence: Streaming is bounded at 512 but lacks parallel worker-local reduction
proposed_mathematical_change: Mergeable Welford/pairwise packets with fixed binary reduction tree for energy force SR RHS matvec and uncertainty
expected_speed_benefit: Approaches worker throughput until kernel/bandwidth saturation
expected_state_evaluation_reduction: No state reduction; elapsed-time reduction only
smallest_falsifying_experiment: Replay identical stream at 1/2/4 workers with predeclared bit/ULP gate and exact counts
rollback_criterion: Nondeterminism lost samples or throughput regression

observed_bottleneck: Fixed 72000 samples over-allocate easy points and may under-allocate hard points
evidence: Force variance differs strongly by geometry and estimator
proposed_mathematical_change: Preregister ESS/autocorrelation-aware confidence stopping with minimum and maximum samples
expected_scientific_benefit: Equalizes uncertainty rather than raw sample count
expected_speed_benefit: Stops easy geometries early; hard geometries may run longer
expected_memory_benefit: O(1) mergeable moments plus bounded autocorrelation state
expected_state_evaluation_reduction: Potentially large sample reduction if empirical coverage passes
scientific_risk: HIGH: optional stopping and heavy-tail undercoverage
smallest_falsifying_experiment: Offline prefix replay of frozen streams with no new samples
rollback_criterion: Undercoverage early false confidence or negligible saving

observed_bottleneck: Brute-force response is extremely expensive and non-definitive
evidence: 3096000 state evaluations per geometry; underdetermined at two points and pathological at one
proposed_mathematical_change: None until science establishes a required response term; matrix-free implicit response only then
expected_memory_benefit: Avoids allocating/optimizing a scientifically unjustified path

observed_bottleneck: No profile demonstrates off-heap memory/vectorization dominates
evidence: Batch 512 bounded memory and no retained electron clouds already pass
proposed_mathematical_change: Profile qualified kernels first; vector/off-heap changes only against a scientific oracle
expected_memory_benefit: Unknown; may reduce allocation or worsen locality
smallest_falsifying_experiment: JFR/allocation and scalar-vs-vector replay after higher-ranked work
rollback_criterion: Any output change or absent measured bottleneck
